purpose: Neutral semantic translation scaffold. Not a garment design and not visual ground truth.

opening_placket.meaning: front opening/placket/zip; side only if physically visible

chest_pocket_panel.meaning: pocket/panel region if architecture requires it

waist_belt.meaning: continuous wrap feature; must remain continuous across visible views

rear_structure.meaning: yoke, storm flap, hood mass, sailor panel, rear seam/vent

featureRules.collar: must attach to neckline and change correctly by view
featureRules.zipper: must follow opening topology and terminate physically
featureRules.pocket: must attach to a garment panel; can disappear when occluded
featureRules.lapel: front collar-opening structure; side shows depth; back does not show lapel faces
featureRules.hood: front opening + side depth + back mass
featureRules.storm_flap: upper-chest/back panel with physically plausible side continuation
featureRules.armhole: for sleeveless garments, must visibly cut into side/shoulder architecture
